small_argument.method: Defining alternating power series evaluated through fixed terms

large_argument.method: Hankel expansion with DLMF 10.17(iii) first-neglected-term remainder theorem

range_reduction_and_elementary_functions.method: Exhaustive round-to-quadrant cell partition plus compositional interval bounds for split phase constants, sine/cosine Taylor tails, and the prefactor constant

whole_domain.excluded: backend floating-point rounding, contraction, and reassociation

floating_point_rounding_reassociation.note: The source proof is conditional only on its explicitly declared IEEE round-to-nearest-even primitives and strict operation tree. It does not infer C, WASM, or WebGPU lowering semantics from oracle agreement.

pinned_compiler_smoke.scope: C/WASM execute certified finite samples and roots. WebGPU is compilation-only. None is a declared release envelope or whole-domain proof.

f32_release_ulp_envelope.scope: all 256 public cached binary32 roots against the correctly rounded mathematical J1 roots

f32_release_residual_envelope.quantity: independent mathematical |J1(r_hat)| at the cached binary32 root
f32_release_residual_envelope.excluded: positive_j1_root_solved mathematical-root/true-residual envelope is certified by separate evidence/solver-root-envelopes.json; implementation-reported residual backend conformance and backend lowering remain open

f64_release_ulp_envelope.scope: all 256 public cached binary64 roots against the correctly rounded mathematical J1 roots

f64_release_residual_envelope.quantity: independent mathematical |J1(r_hat)| at the cached binary64 root
f64_release_residual_envelope.excluded: positive_j1_root_solved mathematical-root/true-residual envelope is certified by separate evidence/solver-root-envelopes.json; implementation-reported residual backend conformance and backend lowering remain open

root_solver_source_graph.scope: all valid indices 1..256 separately in f32/f64; source arithmetic, sign-bracket invariant, stopping, result record, and reported-residual construction
root_solver_source_graph.excluded: solver-root mathematical ULP/true-residual envelopes are separate evidence; C/WASM/WebGPU lowering and runtime conformance remain open

root_solver_mathematical_envelopes.scope: all source-interpreted positive_j1_root_solved outputs for indices 1..256 separately in f32/f64; mathematical-root ULP distance and independent true |J1(root)| residual
root_solver_mathematical_envelopes.excluded: solver bracket containment, implementation-reported approximate residual values, backend lowering/runtime behavior, and release conformance
